basic_details.job_title: Collector Office, Bharuch District Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Law graduates who have practised as advocates for at least seven years, are not less than 35 years and not more than 60 years of age, and have been income tax payers for at least five years before appointment can apply for one post of District Public Prosecutor at the District Court, Bharuch. The Office of the Collector and District Magistrate, Bharuch (કલેક્ટર અને જિલ્લા મેજિસ્ટ્રેટની કચેરી) is preparing a panel for this post. how_to_apply: Download the application form from the office website bharuch.nic.in. A specimen of the form is printed with the notice.
Affix a recent passport-size photograph in the box on the form and sign it.
Fill in all details in the form; the form is addressed to the District Magistrate, Bharuch, with the subject "Appointment of District Public Prosecutor".
Attach certified copies of the documents listed below and list them in the enclosure table at the end of the form.
Send the application only by Speed Post to Office of the Collector and District Magistrate, First Floor, Jilla Seva Sadan, Bharuch – 392001, so that it reaches the office by 23 November 2026.
Certified copy of the date of birth certificate
Certified copies of educational qualification certificates
Copies of income tax returns filed for the last five years, with year-wise annual income and income tax paid
Copy of the Sanad (registration as advocate under Section 17 of the Advocates Act, 1961)
Copy of the certificate issued by the court where practice was started
Certified proofs of any other qualification
important_instructions: Applications with incomplete details will not be considered. Applications received after the fixed time limit will not be considered. The form asks whether any police offence is registered or any court case is pending against the applicant, with details. For enquiries, the office lists phone 02642-243751 and email [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About Collector Office, Bharuch
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Office of the Collector and District Magistrate, First Floor, Jilla Seva Sadan, Bharuch – 392001, Gujarat, and is signed by Dr. Navnath Gavhane, District Magistrate, Bharuch. Following instructions in the Home Department circular No. HD/MIS/e-file/8/2026/3525/L-1 dated 17-07-2026, the Government has decided to form a panel to fill one post of District Public Prosecutor at the Bharuch District Court. The panel is being prepared under Section 18(4) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 and the Prosecuting Officers (Appointment and Conditions of Service) and Conduct of Legal Affairs of Government Rules, 2026.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from law graduates who meet the following conditions laid down under the Rules, 2026: Experience: practising as an advocate for at least seven years. Age: not less than 35 years and not more than 60 years. The notice prints no separate cut-off date for age; the application form asks for the age on the date of application. Income tax: must have been an income tax payer for at least 5 years preceding the appointment.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The candidate appointed after selection will receive fee and other allowances as per the Gujarat Prosecuting Officers (Appointment and Conditions of Service) and Conduct of Legal Affairs of Government Rules, 2026. The notice does not print the amount. The appointee can perform the duties up to a maximum age of 60 years.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Bharuch Collector District Public Prosecutor
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the office website bharuch.nic.in. A specimen of the form is printed with the notice. Affix a recent passport-size photograph in the box on the form and sign it. Fill in all details in the form; the form is addressed to the District Magistrate, Bharuch, with the subject "Appointment of District Public Prosecutor". Attach certified copies of the documents listed below and list them in the enclosure table at the end of the form. Send the application only by Speed Post to Office of the Collector and District Magistrate, First Floor, Jilla Seva Sadan, Bharuch – 392001, so that it reaches the office by 23 November 2026. Certified copy of the date of birth certificate Certified copies of experience certificates Certified copies of educational qualification certificates Copies of income tax returns filed for the last five years, with year-wise annual income and income tax paid Copy of the Sanad (registration as advocate under Section 17 of the Advocates Act, 1961) Copy of the certificate issued by the court where practice was started Certified proofs of any other qualification

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates called for an interview must appear at their own expense with their original certificates on the date, time and place fixed by the office. The notice does not print the interview date or venue.

faq.question: Q1. How many District Public Prosecutor posts are there in Bharuch Collector Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 post of District Public Prosecutor at the District Court, Bharuch.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Bharuch District Public Prosecutor?
faq.answer: The application must reach the Collector office, Bharuch by Speed Post by 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for District Public Prosecutor Bharuch?
faq.answer: Applicants must be law graduates practising as advocates for at least seven years and must have been income tax payers for at least 5 years before appointment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Bharuch District Public Prosecutor?
faq.answer: Applicants must be not less than 35 years and not more than 60 years of age.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of Bharuch District Public Prosecutor?
faq.answer: The appointee gets fee and other allowances as per the Gujarat Prosecuting Officers (Appointment and Conditions of Service) and Conduct of Legal Affairs of Government Rules, 2026.

faq.question: Q6. How to apply for Bharuch District Public Prosecutor 2026?
faq.answer: Download the form from bharuch.nic.in, fill it in, attach the certified copies and income tax returns, and send it only by Speed Post to the Collector office, First Floor, Jilla Seva Sadan, Bharuch – 392001.

faq.question: Q7. Can the application be sent by ordinary post or by hand?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the application form must be sent only by Speed Post.

faq.question: Q8. How will the District Public Prosecutor be selected?
faq.answer: Candidates called for an interview must attend at their own expense with original certificates on the date, time and place fixed by the office.

faq.question: Q9. Which income tax documents are needed?
faq.answer: Copies of the income tax returns of the last five years must be attached, with year-wise annual income and tax paid filled in the form.

faq.question: Q10. Up to what age can the District Public Prosecutor serve?
faq.answer: The appointee can perform the duties up to a maximum age of 60 years.
